cards.name: Shining Brigade - Last Stand
cards.audit_note: Rejected the reported face-down-cost finding. Official archetype-qualified on-field return costs require the monster to be face-up so its archetype is established; the current IsFaceup filter matches that convention.

coverage_override.reason: The two activated effects each incorporate their corresponding clause of the final each-effect HOPT sentence.

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap effect, or a monster effect on the field: You can return 1 "Shining Brigade" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The chain response requires an opponent Spell/Trap effect or an opponent monster effect activated on the field, returns one face-up controlled archetype monster as cost, and negates the effect under its HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official archetype-qualified 'return 1 ... monster you control to the hand' negation cost filters a face-up archetype monster in LOCATION_MZONE with IsAbleToHandAsCost.
Official chain-response effect checks chain disablability and resolves with effect negation.

effects.printed_clause: During the End Phase: You can shuffle up to 3 cards from your GY or banishment into your Deck, then, if you shuffled at least 2 "Shining Brigade" cards with this effect, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The End Phase HOPT selects one to three legal GY/face-up banished cards, shuffles them into Deck/Extra Deck, counts successfully moved archetype cards, and draws one only when at least two were moved.

official_references.matched_structure: Official operation returns selected GY cards to the Deck and validates the operated group before drawing.
Official draw operation uses Duel.IsPlayerCanDraw and Duel.Draw.
